description: HUMAN REVIEW: context-dependent identifiers. The category must be detected with allowKeep=true, take the listed default action per profile, and accept both KEEP and REDACT overrides.

cases.title: private IPv4 in support vs strict
cases.rationale: Private addresses help troubleshooting but reveal internal topology; reviewer decides per destination.

cases.title: loopback IPv4
cases.rationale: Loopback is low risk but strict redacts every supported address.

cases.title: public IPv4 evidence
cases.rationale: Incident evidence keeps attacker addresses; never default for public sharing.

cases.title: unique-local IPv6
cases.rationale: Unique-local IPv6 behaves like RFC1918 for policy.

cases.title: MAC address hardware id
cases.rationale: Hardware IDs can track a device; incident responders may need them.

cases.title: email in support ticket
cases.rationale: Identity is redacted by default in every profile; a human may KEEP a role mailbox.

cases.title: short username field
cases.rationale: Service accounts are often harmless but syntax cannot distinguish them from people.

cases.title: home path username
cases.rationale: CI build users vs personal accounts need human context.

cases.title: bare dotted quad without version context
cases.rationale: Syntax alone cannot tell a four-part version from an IPv4 address; only explicit version/release context exempts it.
